create_binary_classifier_eval: create a BinaryClassifierEval instance with positive and negative sentence lists for binary sentiment classification
run_binary_classifier_eval: run the BinaryClassifierEval with params and batcher to generate sentence embeddings and compute dev/test accuracy
create_creval: create a CREval instance from task_path to evaluate sentiment classification on the CR dataset
create_mreval: create an MREval instance from task_path to evaluate sentiment classification on the MR dataset
create_subjeval: create a SUBJEval instance from task_path to evaluate subjectivity classification on the SUBJ dataset
